name: Mount Pilchuck Trail (Standard Route)
approach: From Granite Falls, follow WA-92 east and then the Mountain Loop Highway roughly 10-11 miles to the Verlot Public Service Center. Continue about 1 mile past Verlot, cross the South Fork Stillaguamish River, and turn right (south) onto Mount Pilchuck Road (FR 42). Follow FR 42 for about 6.8 miles — a mix of paved and rough, washboarded gravel sections that varies by year and maintenance funding — to the Mount Pilchuck Trailhead parking area (roughly 3,000-3,100 ft). In years when FR 42 is gated below the trailhead (common in shoulder season), the hike instead starts from the Heather Lake Trailhead, adding roughly 5 miles and substantial elevation gain each way.
